detail.title: Conveyance device equipped with gripper and vibration-damping method for gripper
detail.abstract: The present invention enables the use of a vibration-damping member having a large area and capable of achieving a sufficient vibration-damping effect and provides a safety mechanism in the event of breakage of the vibration-damping member. A gripper of this conveyance device is equipped with multiple hands. The hand comprises: a fixed member that is attached to an opening/closing member; a finger member that supports an article from below; vibration-damping members that are made of a vibration-damping material, are disposed between the fixed member and the finger member, are mounted on the fixed member, and mount the finger member thereon; and restricting members that restrict the relative position of the finger member with respect to the fixed member. Transmission of vibrations of the fixed member to the finger member is suppressed by the vibration-damping members, and the finger member is restricted by the restricting members from moving toward the fixed member beyond an allowable range.
